decision_record.calculation: Held XLK 10 @ $160, static slice cash $10,000: legacy nav = 10000+1600 = $11,600 -> target sized on phantom cash; treatment nav = slice capital $10,000. Ratchet fixed point under legacy basis: gross*cash/(1-gross) ($490k at gross 0.98).
decision_record.comparison: Archive NAV formula (live cash remainder + held value) vs v3 snapshot, which carries only the static config slice (cash_usd = full capital) or no slice at all.
decision_record.experiment: Fixture A/B on identical bars/positions/slice: treatment (switch ON, capital basis) vs control (switch OFF, legacy cash+held basis), held-position and flat fixtures.
decision_record.mechanism: Risk/sizing perception: the sleeve measured its risk-bearing capacity with cash it does not have; every rebalance oversized targets and invited dispatcher slice-BP rejects.
decision_record.transfer: The rotation edge pays the designed gross exposure to the selected leader; oversizing transfers the surplus to unpriced leverage and BP-reject execution failure.

switch: extra.aster_etf_b9_enh.nav_basis default ON; OFF restores pre-change basis exactly
